enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Bends knees. Pulls blanket up. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Puts hand under pillow. Turns to back. Stretches legs. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns to left side again. Pulls sheet. Remains asleep.
Opens eyes. Blinks. Sits up. Raises arms overhead. Stretches. Yawns. Lowers arms. Swings legs over edge of bed. Places feet on floor. Stands up. Stretches back. Walks toward bathroom.

Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Wets body. Picks up soap. Lathers soap. Washes body. Rinses body. Picks up shampoo. Applies shampoo. Massages scalp. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around waist. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Opens cupboard. Takes out bowl and pan. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Cracks eggs into bowl. Whispers eggs. Pours eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Turns off stove. Slides eggs onto plate. Sits at table. Eats eggs. Drinks milk. Picks up plate. Walks to sink. Rinses plate. Exits kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Opens closet. Selects shirt. Selects pants. Closes closet. Opens dresser drawer. Takes out underwear. Takes out socks. Closes drawer. Removes pajamas. Puts on underwear. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Combs hair. Picks up bag. Picks up phone. Picks up keys. Walks out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to work (staying hydrated in heatwave)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Takes out water bottle. Drinks water. Puts water bottle back. Bus arrives. Steps onto bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Takes out phone. Checks messages. Puts phone away. Drinks water again. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks off bus. Walks to workplace. Opens door. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator at nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Picks up phone. Makes calls. Writes notes. Attends meeting. Takes minutes. Talks to colleague. Files documents. Types report. Prints document. Drinks water. Stands up. Sits down. Continues working.

Walks to cafeteria. Stands in line. Picks up tray. Selects sandwich. Selects salad. Picks up drink. Pays for food. Carries tray to table. Sits down. Eats sandwich. Eats salad. Drinks beverage. Wipes mouth with napkin. Picks up tray. Returns tray. Walks outside. Sits on bench. Stands up. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator at nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Reviews schedule. Makes phone calls. Sends emails. Meets with team. Discusses project. Takes notes. Updates database. Prints flyers. Distributes flyers. Answers phone. Talks to client. Writes report. Files paperwork. Drinks water. Stands up. Stretches. Sits down. Continues working.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Drinks water. Bus arrives. Steps onto bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Takes out phone. Checks messages. Puts phone away. Drinks water. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks off bus. Walks home. Opens door. Enters home.

Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and chicken. Opens cupboard. Takes out pot and pan. Turns on stove. Cuts vegetables. Adds vegetables to pot. Cooks chicken in pan. Turns off stove. Pours soup into bowl. Places chicken on plate. Sits at table. Eats with spoon. Drinks water. Picks up dishes. Walks to sink. Rinses dishes. Loads dishwasher. Exits kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with air conditioning
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Turns on air conditioner. Sits on couch. Changes channel. Watches show. Picks up phone. Puts phone down. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Gets snack. Returns to couch. Sits down. Eats snack. Turns off TV. Turns off air conditioner. Stands up. Walks out.

Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Rinses. Applies shampoo. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Brushes teeth. Applies toothpaste. Rinses mouth. Hangs towel. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

Enters bedroom. Turns on fan. Sits at desk. Opens computer. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens browser. Opens document. Types. Saves document. Closes computer. Picks up book. Lies on bed. Opens book. Reads pages. Closes book. Places book on nightstand. Turns off light. Lies down.

Enters bedroom. Turns on fan. Opens closet. Takes out pajamas. Closes closet. Removes clothes. Puts on pajamas. Walks to bathroom. Uses toilet. Washes hands. Returns to bedroom. Sets alarm on phone. Places phone on nightstand. Turns off light. Lies down in bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes.

Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Bends knees. Pulls blanket up. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Puts hand under pillow. Turns to back. Stretches legs. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns to left side again. Pulls sheet. Remains asleep.
